name: PhantomBuster
description: PhantomBuster is a cloud automation platform for running prebuilt Phantoms that collect, enrich, and move go-to-market data across web and business workflows.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned Workspace API key and one exact permanent Phantom/Agent ID. Agents may read only a bounded redacted status summary from the fixed v2 Agent fetch endpoint. Relay excludes launches, schedules, aborts, arguments, credentials, cookies, output/logs/messages/events, result files/URLs, S3 paths, other agents/containers, scripts, mutations, polling, streaming, chaining, bulk work, downloads, and exports.

capabilities.label: Read Phantom status
capabilities.description: Read one bounded redacted status summary for the exact configured Phantom/Agent ID.

approvalRequired.label: Read Phantom status
approvalRequired.description: Read one bounded redacted status summary for the exact configured Phantom/Agent ID.

blocked.label: Run or stop Phantoms
blocked.description: Launching, scheduling, retrying, chaining, aborting, or overriding arguments for Phantoms or Workflows is outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private outputs
blocked.description: Console output, messages, runtime events, arguments, saved configuration, cookies, credentials, people/contact data, result objects, files, S3 paths, and download URLs are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Phantoms
blocked.description: Creating, saving, updating, copying, sharing, or deleting agents, scripts, branches, organizations, or settings is outside V1.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Other agents, containers, origins, API versions, endpoints, methods, headers, query parameters, payloads, scripts, and raw API access are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export automation data
blocked.description: Output streaming, polling, automatic pagination, crawling, synchronization, bulk launches, file inputs, webhooks, downloads, and exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded private Agent status read requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected status read runs without Relay approval while exact Agent ID, fixed endpoint, audit, redaction, and response bounds remain enforced; launches and output access stay blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one bounded approval-gated Phantom status read and keeps the Workspace key encrypted.
Relay mounts one bounded approval-gated Phantom status read and keeps the Workspace key encrypted.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned PhantomBuster account, dedicated Workspace API key, exact preconfigured Agent ID, or live acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task create a dedicated Workspace key, choose and preconfigure one Phantom, record its exact Agent ID, store both through Relay, then validate status binding, approval/denial, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial without launching it or retrieving output.

evidence.supports: Official API overview documents HTTPS JSON APIs, v2 as current, Workspace API keys, header authentication, and broad launch/output/script authority.
Official v2 reference documents GET https://api.phantombuster.com/api/v2/agents/fetch with required Agent ID and X-Phantombuster-Key header.
Official support documents the permanent numeric Agent/Phantom ID and its use for status and result operations.
